title: BPSK Demodulator Baseband
text: 解调 BPSK 调制数据，输入 2 路、输出 1 路；按 {Noise variance} 指定噪声方差；{Decision type} 指定判决类型 Hard、{Noise variance source} 指定噪声方差源、{Phase offset (rad)} 指定第 0 个点的相位、{Output data type} 输出数据类型 Inherit via internal、{Derotate factor} 指定去旋转因子 Same word length，按实例取值。

ports.name: In
ports.summary: BPSK 调制的基带信号 scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: Var
ports.summary: 噪声方差 positive scalar | vector of positive values

params.name: Decision type
params.values: 判决类型 Hard decision (default) | Log-likelihood ratio | Approximate log-likelihood ratio

params.name: Noise variance
params.values: 噪声方差 1 (default) | positive scalar | vector of positive values

params.name: Phase offset (rad)
params.values: 第 0 个点的相位 0 (default) | real-valued scalar

params.name: Output data type
params.values: 输出数据类型 Inherit via internal rule (default) | Smallest unsigned integer | double | single |...

params.name: Derotate factor
params.values: 去旋转因子 Same word length as input (default) | Specify word length
